verdict.rationale: Letta ships a dedicated shared-memory feature (`letta shared-memory create`, Git-backed shared repositories giving multiple agents common context) alongside per-agent private memory blocks, and pricing docs explicitly mention team-level agent sharing with configurable permissions. This directly matches sharing selected memory across agents/users while keeping other memory private. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the privacy boundary enforcement and finer-grained detail on how access permissions are scoped per user vs team.
